about: What exists on chain of HELP WANTED, read at one pinned block. Written by scripts/evidence/build.ts (pnpm evidence) and by nothing else; do not edit by hand.
houseRule: HOUSE is the activity of the wallets the team publishes in evidence/house-wallets.json and of HELP WANTED's own contracts; everything else is OUTSIDE. Each event is counted for one account: the one that made the call, the one the event pays, or the one an earlier event settled (the opener of a round, the employer of an order). When the account made the call itself, the count is HOUSE if that account or the sender of the transaction is on the list. scripts/evidence/contracts.ts holds the rule of every event.
